form.title: My details
form.subtitle: Everything about you is here. Visibility for particular people is set per Group on the «Circle» page.
form.requisitesText: Only the managers of organizations where you work see this data — for contracts, employment and payouts. Friends and colleagues do not see it (colleagues — only if you turn it on below under «Visibility in Companies»).
form.middleNameHint: Printed in the full name in orders and contracts
form.payoutCardNote: The payout card is added in the «Wallet» section.
form.dobPartial: Date of birth: fill in day, month and year (or clear all three fields)
form.dobInvalid: Date of birth: no such date exists
form.iinInvalidLong: IIN: 12 digits, check the number — the checksum does not match

visibility.defaultText: What a person from your circle sees when you have not added them to any Group yet. Name, surname, phone and role are always visible. Saved automatically.
visibility.companyText: What colleagues in organizations see on your card in the «Employees» section. Name, surname, phone and position are always visible. Saved automatically.
visibility.managersText: Managers (Manager and above) of organizations where you work always see:
visibility.managersList: IIN, date of birth, home address, ID document and the main card
visibility.managersTail: — this is the data for contracts, employment and payouts. It cannot be turned off; ordinary colleagues do not see it until you turn the switches above on.

card.title: My card
card.previewAria: Whose eyes to look at the card through
card.note: This is how your card looks to «{name}». The data is changed on the «My details» tab, group visibility — on the «Circle» page.

language.label: Interface language
language.regionHint: Formats do not depend on the interface language: the product lives in Kazakhstan.
language.timezoneHint: Used for the texts that reach you outside the app (push, SMS, e-mail).

security.title: Security
security.currentText: Ending it will sign you out of the account on this device.
security.passwordPhoneText: Both operations are confirmed with an SMS code. Changing the number requires access to both the current and the new one.

delete.title: Delete the account?
delete.textBefore: The account will be marked for deletion. You have
delete.textAfter: to change your mind — just sign in again and it will be restored. After that the data is deleted permanently.

pwd.title: Change the password
pwd.note: We will confirm with an SMS code to your number. The other sessions will be ended
pwd.doneText: All the other sessions are ended. This one keeps working.

phone.title: Change the number
phone.note: We will confirm BOTH numbers with codes: the current one first, then the new one. If you no longer have access to the current number — the change is not possible yet.
phone.doneText: From now on you sign in with the new number. The other sessions are ended.

skins.title: Card skins
skins.subtitle: The look of your card that people in your circle see. Buy a skin, put it on — and on the premium plan you can set different skins for different groups.
skins.perGroupText: The premium plan lets you show different skins to different groups. If a person is in several groups — the group higher in the circle list wins.
skins.noGroups: First create groups on the «Circle» page.
skins.integerError: Enter a whole number greater than 0

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.subtitle: Your own currency that you reward people with for tasks, and the coins you earned from others.
wallet.noneText: You do not have your own currency yet. Come up with a name and an icon — you will reward people from your circle with it for tasks.
wallet.name: Name
wallet.mintLimit: The issue limit is 10 000 000 coins «in circulation» (balance + held).
wallet.renameLocked: You can change it once in 3 months — after {date}
wallet.deleteConfirm: It will burn for everyone. Sure?
wallet.earnedEmpty: You have not earned other people’s currencies yet.
wallet.integerError: Enter a whole number greater than 0

cards.title: My cards
cards.subtitle: Details for payouts — salaries and refunds. The CVV is never asked for and never stored: card payments are not processed. The primary card is visible to the managers of the organizations where you work.
cards.deleteText: The card {mask} will be removed from your details.
cards.panInvalid: Check the number — the checksum does not match
cards.ibanHint: Kaspi shows it in the card details — bank transfers go to the account
